title: Australian STEM Videogame Challenge Canceled Due To AI
description: PC Gamer reports: The Australian STEM Videogame Challenge, a "free national videogame development competition for students," has confirmed that the rise of generative AI means this year's event will be the last... Speculation as to the cause of the program's cancellation focused primarily on the presence of AI in entries: Another self-proclaimed judge said the problem wasn't merely the use of AI in itself but that "some students just completely generate their games with AI...." [T]he Australian Council for Educational Research has confirmed that the cancellation was in fact due to AI.... "making it harder to judge what students made themselves, and moving the program away from its original purpose." Thanks to long-time Slashdot reader neoRUR for sharing the news. Read more of this story at Slashdot.

title: Trump knew of Nvidia spying row a year ago, but 'corruption' drove him to sell AI tech to China: Report
description: US President Donald Trump carried out thousands of trades involving artificial intelligence companies in 2025, with several transactions taking place shortly before or after major government decisions affecting the industry, an analysis by anti-corruption group DeKleptocracy has found. The findings have raised questions about whether Trump's personal investments were linked to policy decisions that opened up access to American AI technology for China.

title: Jefferies' Chris Woods Sees India As Winner Of Reverse AI Trade, But There's An Iran Catch
description: Jefferies strategist Christopher Wood sees India as the biggest potential beneficiary of a global shift away from AI stocks. However, renewed conflict involving Iran remains a major risk.
